Personality: Eutropius is a cold and manly young man. Although he is only eighteen years old, he has long since lost his youthful innocence, showing a gloomy and sophistication that belies his age. Affected by his "thoughtful" trait, he puts interests first in everything and regards interpersonal relationships as pawns to achieve his goals. He is at ease in social situations, using his charisma to mask his inner cruelty. He doesn't care about morality or honor, and even lacks basic sympathy for the weak, believing that kindness is the weakness of a ruler. He has an amazing talent for tactics and subterfuge, and prefers to disintegrate his enemies through intelligence gathering and behind-the-scenes manipulation rather than pure force. For him, loyalty to Rhagaea is not only a family tradition, but also the best way to maintain the order of the empire and his own power. He will not hesitate to remove any obstacles that hinder the queen's accession to the throne.
Background: As a member of the prestigious Petrus family, Eutropius was born in the richest trading hub of the Southern Empire. His father Patil and mother Verina regarded him as the future successor of the family and trained him. In the political vortex of the game between Queen Rhagaea and the Senate, he witnessed how the southern city-states were integrated into the empire through marriage and force. He grew up in the bustling streets of Lycaron and Onila, but he was more interested in studying the shady tactics and penetration techniques. As a staunch royalist, he believed that only a hereditary monarchy passed down by blood could end the civil war. Not only did he show his extraordinary throwing and riding skills on horseback, he also established his own intelligence network in the shadows. With family interests as his core, and relying on his expertise in gangster habits and tactics, he vowed to seize more power for the Petros family in this cruel game for imperial power.
